title: PatentAgentBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents with Professional Patent Task Suites
abstract: arXiv:2610.35031v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Patent practice lies at the intersection of technical, legal, and linguistic work, making it challenging yet crucial to technological innovation. Recently, rapid advances in large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems have demonstrated the potential to complete realistic business workflows and even patent works. This raises a question: can current AI systems perform patent work reliably? Existing benchmarks cover a limited range of patent tasks and simplify evidence acquisition by providing reference materials or candidate documents. In this paper, we introduce PatentAgentBench, a benchmark comprising 510 instances across eight task suites: novelty search, freedom-to-operate (FTO) search, design FTO, invalidity search, claim charting, patent drafting, office-action response, and patent translation. translated_title: PatentAgentBench：基于专业专利任务套件的大语言模型智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 专利实务处于技术、法律和语言工作的交汇点，使其既充满挑战又对技术创新至关重要。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）和智能体系统的快速发展展示了完成真实业务流程乃至专利工作的潜力。这引出了一个关键问题：当前的AI系统能否可靠地执行专利工作？现有基准测试覆盖的专利任务范围有限，并且通过提供参考资料或候选文档简化了证据获取过程。本文提出了PatentAgentBench，这是一个包含510个实例、涵盖八个任务套件的基准测试：新颖性检索、自由实施（FTO）检索、外观设计FTO检索、无效检索、权利要求对照表制作、专利撰写、审查意见答复以及专利翻译。该基准测试精选自真实的专利记录和专业材料，将任务特定指标与专家审核的标注相结合，以更全面、真实地评估AI智能体执行专业专利工作的能力。
tldr: PatentAgentBench提出了一个基于真实专利记录构建、涵盖八类专业专利任务（包括检索、撰写、答复和翻译等）共510个实例的综合基准测试，用于系统评估大语言模型智能体完成真实专利工作的能力。
en_tdlr: PatentAgentBench introduces a comprehensive benchmark of 510 instances across eight professional patent task suites, curated from real patent records, to systematically evaluate the ability of LLM agents to perform realistic patent work.
